# Stimson Center

> A leading international security think tank providing research and policy analysis on global challenges spanning technology, defense, diplomacy, human security, climate, and regional geopolitics.

The Stimson Center conducts in-depth research across five major domains: Trade & Technology (AI, nonproliferation, arms control), Security & Strategy (defense policy, grand strategy, diplomacy), Human Security & Governance (peacekeeping, human rights, international organizations), Climate & Natural Resources (energy security, critical minerals), and Pivotal Places (Asia-Pacific, China, Japan, Korean Peninsula). The organization serves as a key resource for policymakers and analysts on emerging security threats.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technology
- Nonproliferation & Nuclear Security
- US-China Relations
- Indo-Pacific Strategy
- Arms Control & Trade
- Defense Policy & Military Strategy
- Diplomacy & Conflict Resolution
- Human Rights & International Humanitarian Law
- Peacekeeping & Atrocity Prevention
- Climate & Energy Security
- Critical Minerals & Supply Chains
- North Korea Nuclear Threat
- Taiwan Security
- International Organizations & Governance
- Cyber Security & Dual-Use Technology

## Trade & Technology

- [Artificial Intelligence Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/trade-tech/artificial-intelligence): AI research on governance, global security, and international cooperation.
- [Emerging Technology Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/trade-tech/emerging-tech): Emerging technology research on AI, cyber-security, and innovation policy.
- [Nonproliferation Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/trade-tech/nonproliferation): Nonproliferation research on nuclear security, chemical security, and weapons prevention.
- [Conventional Arms Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/trade-tech/conventional-arms): Conventional arms research on Arms Trade Treaty, arms transfers, and security cooperation.
- [Trade Risk Mitigation Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/trade-tech/trade-risk): Trade risk mitigation research on dual-use controls and export controls.

## Security & Strategy

- [Grand Strategy Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/security-strategy/grand-strategy): Grand strategy research on US foreign policy, Indo-Pacific, and geopolitics.
- [Defense Policy & Posture Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/security-strategy/defense-policy-posture): Defense policy research on military strategy and US-Japan Alliance.
- [Diplomacy & Dialogue Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/security-strategy/diplomacy-dialogue): Diplomacy research on China-US relations, conflict mediation, and military dialogue.

## Asia-Pacific & Regional Security

- [Asia & Indo-Pacific Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/pivotal-places/asia-indopac): Asia and Indo-Pacific research on China, North Korea, and regional security.
- [China Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/pivotal-places/asia-indopac/china): China research on US-China relations, Taiwan, and Middle East engagement.
- [Korean Peninsula Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/pivotal-places/asia-indopac/korean-peninsula): Korean Peninsula research on North Korea and nuclear security via 38 North.
- [Japan Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/pivotal-places/asia-indopac/japan): Japan research on US-Japan alliance and Indo-Pacific security strategy.

## Human Security & Governance

- [Human Rights & IHL Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/human-security-governance/human-rights-ihl): Human rights and IHL research on peacekeeping, atrocity prevention, and protection.
- [Protection of Civilians Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/human-security-governance/protection-civilians): Protection of civilians research on atrocity prevention and genocide prevention.
- [Peacekeeping Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/human-security-governance/peacekeeping): Peacekeeping research on UN peace operations and civilian protection.
- [International & Regional Organizations Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/human-security-governance/intl-orgs): International organizations research on UN, global governance, and climate security.

## Climate, Energy & Natural Resources

- [Critical Minerals Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/climate-natural-resources/critical-minerals): Critical minerals research on supply chains, mining, and China competition.
- [Energy, Water & Oceans Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/climate-natural-resources/energy-water-oceans): Energy and ocean security research on IUU fishing and South China Sea.
- [Resilience & Sustainability Research](https://www.stimson.org/research/climate-natural-resources/resilience-sustainability): Climate resilience and sustainability research on ocean security and governance.
